parsed.summary: After tracing the hierarchical sheets, every value and connection I could read off the drawing matches the specification (FAN53610 buck with 2.2 µF CIN / 10 µF COUT / 1.0 µH LQM2MPN1R0MGHL and EN tied to VIN, MODE to GND, FB to +3V3; EPD boost with 10 µH inductor, 0.47 Ω sense, MCH3478 gate driven from the FPC GDR pin, source through the sense resistor to the RESE pin; NTR2101P high-side display switch with a 10 kΩ gate pull-up driven by the module GPIO; barrel-jack battery-disconnect wiring with the '2 and 3 shorted / 1 center positive' note; SPDT wired to HW_RESET; debug UART TX/RX on the correct module pins). The only differences from the spec are systematic reference/label renaming (e.g. SKW92A as U6, FPC as J7, boost MOSFET as Q3, sense resistor as R3, buck inductor as L3) and auto-generated NETxxxx names, which are drawing conventions and do not change behaviour, so no anomaly is reported.
